name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Educational Institution Doing Outstanding Work In Awareness Generation And Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse
shortTitle: National Awards for Prevention of Abuse
nodalDept: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
targetBeneficiaries: Institutions working in prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
Individuals working in prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
Educational Institutions doing outstanding work in awareness generation and prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
briefDescription: This central scheme recognizes institutions and individuals for outstanding services in preventing alcoholism and substance abuse, specifically educational institutions doing awareness work.
descriptionMd: The 'National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse' is a central scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. It aims to acknowledge and felicitate both institutions and individuals who have demonstrated exemplary work in the crucial area of preventing alcoholism and substance (drug) abuse. This specific category focuses on recognizing educational institutions that have made outstanding contributions to awareness generation and prevention efforts.
benefitsMd:
- Recognition through National Awards for outstanding services
- Acknowledgment for exemplary work in awareness generation and prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse
eligibilityMd:
- Institutions working in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse.
- Individuals working in the field of Prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse.
- Educational Institutions doing outstanding work in awareness generation and prevention of Alcoholism and Substance (Drug) Abuse.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
